```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),      # diff pair L
    "itail": (5.0e-6, 3e-6, 6.5e-6), # preamp tail current
    "i2":    (5.0e-6, 3e-6, 6.0e-6), # gain-stage current
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror / CS gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.4),      # PMOS L
    "gmidb": (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),      # NMOS bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    it, i2 = p["itail"], p["i2"]
    ih = it / 2

    # bias: ibias diode, tail and gain-stage sinks (same L, same gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.75)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], it, vds=0.3)
    m6 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # preamp: NMOS pair, PMOS mirror (diode on vinn side, output on vinp side)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], ih, vds=0.55, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], ih, vds=0.9)
    # gain stage: PMOS CS, scaled copy of the mirror device
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # output inverters
    Wn1, Wp1 = 0.42, 0.84
    Wn2, Wp2 = 2.0, 5.0
    Lmin = 0.15

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d2", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.M("MI1N", "o3", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn1, Lmin)
    n.M("MI1P", "o3", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp1, Lmin)
    n.M("MI2N", "vout", "o3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn2, Lmin)
    n.M("MI2P", "vout", "o3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp2, Lmin)

    # first-order performance model
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout1 = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A1 = gm1 / gout1
    C1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg
    cgi = (Wn1 + Wp1) * Lmin * 10e-15 + 0.6e-15
    C2 = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + cgi
    tau1 = A1 * C1 / gm1
    t1 = tau1 * math.log(2.0)
    s = gm1 * vod / C1
    Q2 = C2 * 1.0
    t2 = max(math.sqrt(2 * Q2 / (m5.gm * s)), Q2 / i2)
    cg2 = (Wn2 + Wp2) * Lmin * 10e-15 + 2e-15
    t3 = cg2 * 0.9 / 60e-6 + cl * 0.9 / 400e-6
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    power = vdd * (iref + it + i2)
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "preamp_gain": A1, "C1": C1, "C2": C2}
```
